svg.title: WELLS CATHEDRAL — CROSSING SCISSOR ARCH & CHAPTER HOUSE PLAN
svg.desc: Cross-section through Wells Cathedral central crossing showing William Joy’s inverted scissor strainer arches and reflected plan of the 16.0 m octagonal Chapter House vault.
